name: Piles
summary: A 4-player partnership card game where teams build stacks on a 4x3 castle to control piles and capture opponent-colored cards for points.
rules_text: 4 players in fixed partnerships sitting across. Deal 10 cards to each player from a 52-card deck, place remaining 12 face-up as a 4x3 castle. Intrinsic values: A=1, 2-10 face, J=11, Q=12, K=13. Player left of dealer starts, play clockwise. On your turn place one hand card onto any castle pile. The color of the first card played determines team colors: that player and partner become that color. Pile value = top card intrinsic +1 per orthogonally adjacent top card of same color -1 per adjacent top card of different color. Same-color plays always allowed. Opposite-color play allowed only if the new pile's total value exceeds the previous top's total value. You may pass; if you pass, player to your left takes a random card from your hand to keep. After 10 turns each, each team collects piles topped with their color. Score only opponent-color cards inside them: A=9, K=4, Q=3, J=2, others=1. Highest scoring team wins.
